text:
Maya: Quick poll: coffee or tea for the 3pm break? ☕️🍵
akira-bot: Poll posted: :coffee: = coffee, :tea: = tea
Tom: coffee. strong. like my opinions.
Rohit: tea. polite and slightly mysterious.
Nina: coffee but only if someone brings biscotti.
Maya: biscotti it is. winner buys next round of jokes.
Tom: I will accept the role of official joke distributor.
Rohit: One-liner to warm up: "Did you hear about the restaurant on the moon? Great food, no atmosphere." :grin:
Nina: OK that was good. I'll bring biscotti and silence.
